about_the_game:
The Heart of Gold is a Bullet Heaven game with RPG mechanics that offer a deep and highly replayable experience. Each character has their own combat style thanks to a unique stat scaling system, two active skills, one passive skill, and one ultimate skill, allowing you to develop varied strategies in each game.

Face thousands of enemies as you traverse maps infested with creatures. Collect weapons and accessories along the way, upgrade your equipment, and survive to the end to face the ultimate boss. Run, dodge, and fight through intense waves of enemies, and prove your mastery before time runs out.

Enjoy a colorful and attractive visual style, with real-time lighting, dynamic shadows, and day and night cycles that bring the game world to life.

Between games, you can return to the mothership base: a refuge where you can rest, change characters, upgrade your equipment, unlock additional content, and talk to characters to discover more about their stories.

One of the most distinctive features is its gachapon system, which works exclusively with coins obtained in the game. The cards obtained not only have unique illustrations but also influence the base and scaling statistics of the characters, offering new tactical possibilities.

Each weapon has its own mechanics. Some evolve when they reach their maximum level, while others require a specific accessory in your inventory to unlock their most powerful form. In addition, you can upgrade weapons at the blacksmith to enhance their basic attributes.

In each run, venture into the dungeons, which change the gameplay to a turn-based RPG while maintaining the fast-paced essence and waves of enemies. Use up to 14 characters in combat, divided into two teams of seven, to obtain equipment, materials, coins, and extra experience.

With 18 visually distinctive characters, including several from different worlds and with their own stories, the game offers narrative depth and gameplay variety. Currently, 7 of them are playable, and each one features voice acting planned in Spanish, English, and Japanese.

Introducing

A little girl brought from another universe, who possesses unique powers unknown even to those skilled in magic or technology. With a noble character and friendly attitude, she is one of the playable characters intended for players specializing in “glass cannon” archetype characters.

An aspiring knight, she is very positive, with a cheerful and somewhat noisy attitude. She is a little silly and very confident in herself. Thanks to her high health and defense, she is the perfect character for players new to the genre.

A Slime girl who wields magic, with a shy and very introverted personality, she specializes in ghost magic. She has high movement speed and area attack, making her perfect as a damage-specialized (DPS) character.

Furthermore, you can expand your gaming experience by exploring the extras menu, where you can access character profiles, a weapon almanac, a card gallery, an enemy bestiary, and unlockable conversations with voice files. Everything is designed to enhance immersion and uncover the secrets of this world.

name: The Heart of Gold
short_description: The Heart of Gold is a Bullet Heaven game with RPG elements, where each character is unique thanks to their own abilities, progression, and combat style. Upgrade your equipment, evolve your weapons, collect cards, and survive hordes of enemies in a colorful world full of secrets and challenges.
